paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: comparison by language family.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of task counts across various language families. The horizontal axis represents language families, listed alphabetically as IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled “task count,” extends from 0 to approximately 40 and utilizes a linear scale. The bars represent the number of tasks completed for each language family, with each family color-coded as follows: blue for mBERT, light blue for XLM-R, green for IE-Slavic, and dark green for the “same” category. The IE-Germanic language family has the tallest bar, reaching approximately 13, while the Isolate and Semitic language families have bars that reach approximately 5.  The IE-other language family has a bar of approximately 6, and the Uralic language family has a bar of approximately 4. The bars depicting the IE-Slavic and IE-Romance language families are the shortest, reaching approximately 8 and 7 respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular fashion, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
